chunks: One of our companions, from Ali ibn al-Hasan al-Mithammi, from Harun ibn Hamza, from one of our companions, from Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him) who said:
The creature does not die until the seed from which he was created comes out of him, either from his mouth or from his eyes.
ai.seo_question: What is the physical sign that confirms death according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this hadith from Al-Kafi identifies the expulsion of the seminal fluid (nutfa) as the definitive physiological marker of death, linking the end of life to the return of the creative essence. This concept underscores the continuity between creation and dissolution, emphasizing that death is not merely the cessation of breath but the final release of the body's foundational substance. It serves as a key criterion in determining the validity of funeral rites and ritual purity procedures.

en.hubeali: One of our companions, from Ali Bin Al Hassan Al Maysami, from Haroun Bin Hamza, from one of our companions,

(It has been narrated) from Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The creature is not dying until the seed comes out from him, that which he was Created from, either from his mouth, or from his eyes’.
en.sarwar: 3. Certain persons of our people have narrated from Ali ibn al-Hassan al-Mithamiy from Harun ibn Hamzah from certain persons of our people who has said the following: “
Ali ibn al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that a creature does not die until the seed from which it is created comes out through his mouth or his eye.”
